newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SBC aims for 1997 profit of 1.7 bln Sfr. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SBC aims for 1997 profit of 1.7 bln Sfr. [CORRECTED 11:30 GMT]

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) said on Wednesday its goal was to achieve a group net profit of 1.7 billion Swiss francs ($1.4 billion) in 1997 and then raise profit to 2.5 billion francs by the year 1999 or 2000.
The profit targets were outlined in a statement issued by the bank at a news conference.
"We are very confident that we will reach our mid-term goals," SBC chief executive Marcel Ospel said, referring to the profit goal for 1999 or 2000.
Earlier today SBC unveiled a sweeping restructuring of its domestic divisions and a change in its provisioning method, resulting in 1996 charges of some 3.3 billion francs.
This is expected to lead to a group net loss of 1.9 billion francs for 1996 compared with a net gain (Corrects from net loss) of 1.05 billion in 1995.
